name: Dhikr Rotunda
summary: A prayer-bead arc becomes the dome of a rounded mosque with a small square minaret.
why: The bead string is the roof itself. Its two ends meet the facade corners at exactly y=49, and the central doorway is aligned to the dome at x=57.5.
risk: The beads read as a softly scalloped dome at 24px. Their individual rhythm is clearer at 48px and above.
sub1: Prayer beads form the roof rather than a separate badge
sub2: Door and beaded dome share the same vertical axis
reasonToChoose: A prayer-bead arc becomes the dome of a rounded mosque with a small square minaret.
